 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Napoli are again weighing up a move for Udinese centre-back Oumar Solet, although any deal looks more likely next summer than in January.
 According to TuttoMercatoWeb , the Partenopei have kept the Frenchman on their radar after considering him during the last transfer window. Talks stalled then because Udinese's asking price was too high, and Inter dropped their own interest in Solet for the same reason, signing John Stones instead.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Defence is not Napoli's main concern for January. They want at least one midfielder and a striker. Udinese are a familiar trading partner for the Partenopei, however, and a defensive rebuild could follow at the end of the season.
 NAPLES, ITALY – JULY 14: Aurelio De Laurentiis as Massimiliano Allegri is unveiled as the new head coach at Teatro di San Carlo on July 14, 2026 in Naples, Italy. (Photo by Francesco Pecoraro/Getty Images)
 Napoli midfield and attack targets
 Napoli's list of midfield targets keeps growing. It includes Lassana Coulibaly, Zorgane, Cagliari's Alessandro Romano, Bergwall and Aranda. Romano is owned by Roma, but Cagliari can buy him for €5m.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement In attack, Monza striker Gustavo Varela is the most concrete option, but the Brianzoli don't want to sell. Varela faces Napoli tonight.
 MONZA, ITALY – AUGUST 14: Gustavo Varela of AC Monza celebrates scoring his team's second goal during the Coppa Italia first round match between AC Monza and US Avellino at Stadio Brianteo on August 14, 2026 in Monza, Italy. (Photo by Marco Luzzani/Getty Images)
 Solet is currently sidelined with a leg problem and missed both the defeat to Milan and tonight's trip to Parma.
